name: Environmental Engineering Analytical Laboratory
description: NABL accredited facility equipped with AAS, ICP-MS, HPLC, and UV-Vis spectrophotometers for trace heavy metal and organic water pollutant detection.
capabilities: Heavy metal detection (Arsenic, Fluoride, Lead); BOD/COD estimation; toxic organic analysis; water potability testing

name: Hydrogeology and Groundwater Simulation Lab
description: High-end computational and experimental lab equipped with MODFLOW suites, borehole loggers, and geophysical resistivity meters.
capabilities: Aquifer recharge modeling; borehole resistivity profiling; 3D hydrogeological mapping; solute transport simulation

name: Centre of Excellence in IoT and Edge Computing
description: Equipped with LoRaWAN gateways, embedded development boards (Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano, ESP32), and edge testing racks.
capabilities: Wireless sensor prototyping; LoRa long-range telemetry; embedded edge AI inference; hardware benchmarking

name: State Remote Sensing & Digital Image Processing Centre
description: Specialized lab housing ERDAS Imagine, ArcGIS Enterprise, ENVI, and photogrammetric workstations with high-resolution satellite repositories.
capabilities: Satellite image multispectral analysis; watershed boundary demarcation; drought indices; urban runoff mapping

name: Environmental Hydraulics and Waste Characterization Lab
description: Equipped for municipal solid waste proximate/ultimate analysis, calorific value determination (bomb calorimeter), and pilot aerobic/anaerobic reactors.
capabilities: Waste characterization; biomethane potential testing; pilot composting; municipal effluent treatment

name: Advanced Highway and Pavement Engineering Testing Facility
description: Equipped with repeated load triaxial test apparatus, CBR testing machines, and asphalt concrete fatigue analyzers.
capabilities: Pavement material testing; industrial slag aggregate evaluation; soil stabilization mix design; CBR strength testing

name: Solar Thermal and Renewable Energy Systems Lab
description: Solar simulator, pyrheliometer arrays, flat-plate and parabolic trough testing setups for thermal storage benchmarking.
capabilities: Solar efficiency evaluation; thermal storage testing; heat pipe characterization; prototype solar dryers

name: Plant Disease Diagnosis & Bio-Control Research Laboratory
description: Equipped with laminar air flow chambers, PCR thermocyclers, gel documentation systems, and regional fungus/bacterial culture banks.
capabilities: Crop pathogen isolation; fungal blast identification; bio-fungicide development; seed pathology testing

name: Soil Health Diagnostic and Micronutrient Profiling Lab
description: Houses Flame Photometers, Kjeldahl nitrogen analyzers, spectrophotometers, and soil mechanical analysis sieves.
capabilities: NPK macro-nutrient profiling; micronutrient (Zinc, Boron, Iron) quantification; soil pH and lime requirement determination

name: Epidemiology Surveillance and Public Health Field Unit
description: Central field epidemiological lab coordinating sentinel surveillance, rural field health stations, and diagnostic blood testing.
capabilities: Epidemic outbreak investigation; vector-borne screening; primary care diagnostic reporting; community health auditing

name: Computer Vision and Multimodal AI Compute Cluster
description: Dedicated server cluster powered by NVIDIA RTX GPUs for deep vision training, vernacular speech synthesis, and real-time video analytics.
capabilities: Object detection model training; vernacular speech recognition inference; edge AI optimization; dataset annotation

name: Phytoremediation and Ecological Restoration Experimental Plot
description: Open-air and greenhouse experimental soil containment bays designed for assessing heavy metal bioaccumulation in plateau plant species.
capabilities: Hyperaccumulation bioassays; mine soil rehabilitation trials; organic pollutant microbial degradation tracking
